item.title: fix(ui): commentary survives refresh after steering (#121449)
item.summary: fix(ui): commentary survives refresh after steering (#121449) * fix(ui): preserve commentary across steered refreshes Retain keyed active-run commentary and its original timestamps so Control UI reloads keep progress on the correct side of persisted steering messages. Closes #121448 * refactor(ui): simplify active-run replay coverage Reuse the run-bound lookup and remove redundant transcript, hydration, and browser-test setup while preserving the steering refresh regression contract.
